name: Aki High!
source:
As a 16-year-old just arriving in Tokyo, your path through school clubs and a strange virus named Lenny uncovers buried secrets in the city and within you.

[From [url=https://charlestontate.itch.io/aki-high-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一名刚刚抵达东京的16岁青少年，你在学校俱乐部和名为莱尼的奇怪病毒中的经历揭开了这座城市和你内心埋藏的秘密。

[来自[url=https://charlestontate.itch.io/aki-high-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
